notes:
- Find & Replace remembers last-used options (scope, checkboxes, toggles) across sessions
- Find & Replace simplified — configuration presets dropped, dialog is leaner
- Fix Line Patterns and other long summaries scroll instead of overflowing
- Preferences update channel picker is now a pill toggle; switching to Stable from a Preview build correctly offers the latest stable release
- Usage Stats toggle moved inside the "what is sent" window
- Fix Line Patterns shows already-correct patterns alongside ones it will update; reports if nothing needs fixing
- All resizable SDX dialogs remember their size between sessions
- Scrollbars across all SDX dialogs styled dark and slim
- Ribbon panels that contain only hidden tools are now hidden automatically
